metadata.description: SkaFld VC: venture capital agents and skills for Claude Code and Cowork. Start with SkaFld VC; add SkaFld VC Platform only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc
plugins.description: Start here. Sourcing, screening, diligence plans, IC memos and portfolio reviews, with returns, valuation, term sheets, unit economics and cap tables, from your own documents. Exa and Apollo research, branded HTML, Word, PDF, deck and Excel exports. Works with no platform.

plugins.name: skafld-vc-platform
plugins.displayName: SkaFld VC Platform (for SkaFld platform customers)
plugins.description: Only if your firm runs a SkaFld VC platform: connects SkaFld VC to your firm's pipeline, documents, rubric and house profile, and installs SkaFld VC with it. Asks for your platform's address. No platform? Use SkaFld VC on its own, or contact hello@skafldstudio.com to get one.
